data.title: Every finite group admits a just finite presentation
data.description: arXiv:2605.10402v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A finite presentation < X | R > of a finite group is called `just finite' if removing any relation from R results in a presentation for an infinite group. It has been an open question (Kourovka Notebook, Problem 21.10) whether every finite group admits such a presentation. We resolve this conjecture in the affirmative.
data.author: Marc Lackenby
